iti32:1.1: (Duk. I.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttamarahatā ti me sutaṃ.
iti32:2.1: Dvīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato puggalo yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye. Katamehi dvīhi? Pāpakena ca sīlena pāpikāya ca diṭṭhiyā. Imehi kho bhikkhave dvīhi dhammehi samannāgato puggalo yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye ti. Etam-atthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetaṃ iti vuccati:
iti32:3.1: Pāpakena ca sīlena pāpikāya ca diṭṭhiyā | etehi dvīhi dhammehi yo samannāgato naro | kāyassa bhedā duppañño nirayaṃ so upapajjatīti ||
iti32:4.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||5||
